description.value: Wahous Wilderness Lodge is an Indigenous-owned floating retreat resting in the sheltered waters of Quait Bay within Ahousaht territory, deep in Clayoquot Sound. The lodge features 16 private guest rooms with waterfront decks, four secluded cabins, a cedar longhouse, a shoreline spa, and tide-to-table dining at its on-site restaurant. Stays are all-inclusive and immersive, centred on Nuu-chah-nulth cultural experience and soft adventure in old-growth rainforest.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Wahous Wilderness Lodge is open for the 2026 season, provides a phone number (778-488-5737) and mailing address not in OSM, and describes a remote floating lodge in Quait Bay accessible only by water. No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, laundry, tools, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site. OSM's internet_access=wlan tag cannot be confirmed from website content, so Wi-Fi is left null per instructions.
concerns: Lodge is accessible only by water (floating lodge in Quait Bay); no road or cycling access to the property itself — cyclists would need water transport to reach it.
Phone number 778-488-5737 sourced from website only; OSM record contains no phone.
OSM physical address (1 Quait Bay) not confirmed by website, which lists only a P.O. Box mailing address (P.O. Box 1245, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational accommodation confirmed open for the 2026 season. Remote waterfront lodges of this type are legitimate directory entries for touring cyclists seeking overnight accommodation in the Tofino/Clayoquot Sound area.
enrichment_extras.notes: All-inclusive multi-night stays; bookings via email at bookings@wahouswildernesslodge.com or by phone. Website mailing address: P.O. Box 1245, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0.
